            vd = 1 if sum(vs)/len(vs) > r else -1
            break
    if corner is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Components in the quadrant opposite the pointer arms; favor irregular
    # shapes, as the pointer singles out the anomalous object.

                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
